answer.method_summary: Prospective adaptive rule: require one successful item-bound score_variant_fm receipt per candidate; because the available evidence is limited to generic ESM-2 sequence plausibility and ESM-IF1 backbone-conditioned likelihood and is mechanistically misaligned with the declared label-free aggregation/stability endpoint, enter the fallback branch rather than treating either signal as a causal assay model. Across the frozen ten-item comparison candidate set, z-standardize ESM-2 delta log probability and ESM-IF1 mean log likelihood separately, average the two z-scores with equal 0.5 weights, and rank higher composite values first (stable mutant-label ascending tie-break). The endpoint's higher-is-preferred direction determines descending prioritization, but no measured aggregation outcome is claimed; the ordering is a weak generic-plausibility prioritization only. Select ranks 1-10 and reject ranks 11-100; missing/invalid evidence would be a coverage failure, never imputed as zero.
